questions.exam_year_tag: GATE PH Topic • Nuclear & Particle Physics #2
questions.question_en: According to the single-particle Nuclear Shell Model (with spin-orbit coupling), what are the ground-state spin and parity (J^π) of the ¹⁷₈O nucleus?
questions.question_hi: एकल-कण नाभिकीय कोश मॉडल (Nuclear Shell Model) के अनुसार, ¹⁷₈O नाभिक की मूल अवस्था का प्रचक्रण और समता (Spin-Parity, J^π) क्या है?
questions.explanation_en:
STEP-BY-STEP DERIVATION:
1. In ¹⁷₈O, there are Z = 8 protons (magic number, closed shell) and N = 17 - 8 = 9 neutrons.
2. The first 8 neutrons completely fill the closed shells (1s₁/₂)² (1p₃/₂)⁴ (1p₁/₂)².
3. The 9th (unpaired valence) neutron enters the next available level: 1d₅/₂.
4. For a d-orbital, orbital angular momentum l = 2, so parity π = (-1)^l = (-1)² = +1 (even), and j = 5/2.
5. Thus J^π = (5/2)⁺.
questions.explanation_hi:
चरणबद्ध हल:
1. ¹⁷₈O नाभिक में Z = 8 प्रोटॉन (पूर्ण कोश) और N = 9 न्यूट्रॉन हैं।
2. प्रथम 8 न्यूट्रॉन (1s₁/₂)² (1p₃/₂)⁴ (1p₁/₂)² को पूर्णतः भर देते हैं और 9वाँ अयुग्मित न्यूट्रॉन 1d₅/₂ उपकोश में जाता है।
3. d-कक्षक के लिए l = 2 है, अतः समता π = (-1)² = + तथा j = 5/2 ⇒ J^π = (5/2)⁺।

1. In ¹⁷₈O, there are Z = 8 protons (magic number, closed shell) and N = 17 - 8 = 9 neutrons.
2. The first 8 neutrons completely fill the closed shells (1s₁/₂)² (1p₃/₂)⁴ (1p₁/₂)².
3. The 9th (unpaired valence) neutron enters the next available level: 1d₅/₂.
4. For a d-orbital, orbital angular momentum l = 2, so parity π = (-1)^l = (-1)² = +1 (even), and j = 5/2.
5. Thus J^π = (5/2)⁺.
